en.title: House Destruction — Count Segments After Each Removal
en.description:
You are given distinct initial house coordinates and distinct demolition queries; each query demolishes one currently existing house. Output the number of remaining contiguous house segments after each demolition.

The parts marked 'added by this site' and the standard input/output protocol were explicitly compiled by this site; they do not mean the original problem has other unstated rules.
en.input: The first line contains n q; the second line contains n initial coordinates; the third line contains q demolition coordinates. 1≤n≤200000, 1≤q≤n; coordinates range over −10^9..10^9, and every query is one of the initial houses, with no repeats.
en.output: Output the number of contiguous segments after each demolition, in order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
